recipe.provenance: 57840 positions from 1024 v1 games at 32768 nodes plus 15560 rows exclusively from old training; two censored games preserved and excluded
recipe.holdout_limitation: Reuses the v2 holdout; not a fresh external generalization test. No v2 weights or match records enter training.
recipe.trainable: 4096x512 int16 wall deltas, initialized zero, QAT bounded [-8,+8]
recipe.selection: One GPU run; lowest validation blend loss; test loss after selection; never tune from panel

panel.boundary: Displayed LOS 100.0%/0.0%; finish pending pairs and recheck, resume within cap if boundary lost
panel.at_cap: NEUTRAL_SCREEN for selection, not statistical equivalence
panel.early_rejection: Owner delegates manual neutral or clear loss adjudication before cap or remaining TCs; preserve raw stats and incomplete pairs, document reason
panel.promotion: Only three valid WIN controls, independent referee/pair/hash/process audits and finished distribution/interfaces
panel.referee: Hash-pinned independent Chess.com client through audit adapter

constraints.misere: Paused by owner; do not contact
constraints.release: Only after final decision and exit of all owned processes
